name: Tetris Classic
shortDescription: Classic Tetris with mobile-first touch controls, ghost piece, levels, and scoring.

generation.notes: Tetris clone with 7 tetrominoes, SRS wall kicks, ghost piece, touch swipe + button controls, keyboard support, level progression, and line scoring.

suggestion.prompt: Create a Tetris clone. Requirements: Make it work very well on phones in portrait orientation. Use touch-first controls with large buttons that are easy to tap. Also support keyboard controls for desktop testing. Gameplay: Classic Tetris rules: 10-column board, tetromino spawning, left/right/down movement, rotation with reasonable wall kicks or simple fallback logic, hard drop, line clearing, scoring/level progression/line count, game over detection. Include: next piece preview, score display, level display, lines cleared display, restart button, pause button.
